author: Stahly
description:
The Ogor Mawtribes have gorged themselves on a massive new wave of releases, and we're serving up every last morsel: Redd the Maw, Morga the Mighty, Hunters with Sabrefangs, Cleavers, Gutseers, the new Butcher, Grell Ironfist, and more. In this unboxing you'll find high-res sprue images for every kit, a full breakdown of build options, and our honest verdict on whether this is the biggest glow-up the Ogors have ever had. Fair warning: this review has quite the belly on it, so settle in.

The post The massive Mawtribes review: Morga, Redd the Maw, Hunters, Cleavers, Gutseers & Grell Ironfist appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: The massive Mawtribes review: Morga, Redd the Maw, Hunters, Cleavers, Gutseers & Grell Ironfist
